A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the level of Q-QS codes in the electrocardiographic leads can be used to quantitate the extent of left and right ventricular impairment in subjects with healed myocardial injury.
the level of left ventricular dysfunction is proportional to the level of Q-QS codes present in each electrocardigraphic cardiac area.
the left ventricular efferent fraction can be estimated from the level of significance (Q-QS codes) of electrocardiographically detected damage.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the level of left ventricular dysfunction can be estimated from a single electrocardiogram by using the Minnesota Q-QS code and multiple regression analysis.
a mathematical relationship can be derived between Q-QS codes and the left ventricular ejections fraction.
